change.text: Restating the standing practice so it is on paper in plainer words: whenever a slip becomes available, the person who has been on the waiting list longest is the one who gets the offer. This says the same thing as the existing practice and changes nothing about it.

truth.why: The change only restates the waitlist rule in other words and revokes nothing, so every decision stands as it is. D4 and D5 already fixed Kestrel in slip C-14 from 1 October at the south dock rate, and the restated rule produces exactly the same outcome. Option b wrongly acts on the north dock opening in F12 and its rate in F8, option d wrongly applies the winter storage rate from F4, and option c needlessly disrupts Pepper's paid stay, which runs to 30 September.
